notes.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets is now live!
notes.content:
Exciting news for fans of The Quintessential Quintuplets! Both games are now available on Steam with a special launch discount of 10% for the next seven days!

Explore the charming stories of "The Quintessential Quintuplets - Memories of a Quintessential Summer" and "The Quintessential Quintuplets - Five Memories Spent With You" at a discounted price:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507610/The_Quintessential_Quintuplets__Memories_of_a_Quintessential_Summer/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507620/The_Quintessential_Quintuplets__Five_Memories_Spent_With_You/

For even greater savings, consider purchasing the bundle, which includes both titles at an additional 15% off. This discount is on top of the launch discount!

Please note that due to the features of the Steam store, the bundle may not appear on the individual game pages immediately after release. You can find and purchase the bundle directly here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37245/The_Quintessential_Quintuplets_Double_Pack/][Store Page Link][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37245/The_Quintessential_Quintuplets_Double_Pack/

Don’t miss this opportunity to dive into these delightful adventures with the Nakano quintuplets!
